newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends mostly up, spread widens.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends mostly up, spread widens.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures ended mostly higher, with the December/March spread widening as the front month gained on shortcovering and a lack of sell orders, traders said.

"It was a late shortcovering push but also a lack of anything on the sell side. Nobody was there to sell it -- and there's no better buyer than a scared short, which is why we went up so high in the Dec," a trader said.
MGE spring wheat closed two cents lower to 7-1/4 cents higher, with December up 7-1/4 cents at $4.20-1/2 a bushel. March gained 1-1/2 cents to close at $3.89-3/4.
It was the highest close in the MGE December contract since Oct 14, when December closed at $4.22.
Traders said the market firmed early as Cargill (CIS) attempted to cover its shorts in the December contract.
"Cargill came in as we were trading lower and bid for about 300,000 Dec. That's what stopped the bleeding and kind of turned the whole thing around," a trader said earlier.
Traders said today's shortcovering was supporting the Dec/March inverted spread, which traded early at 22 cents but widened to 29 cents.

Wilson Trading reportedly bear-spread one million March/Dec at between 23 and 24 cents. Country Hedging bear-spread 500,000 March/Dec at 22 to 23 cents. Benson-Quinn bull-spread at least 800,000 Dec/March at 22 to 23 cents.
CIS bought 1.6 million Dec. Wilson sold 1.6 million March and one million Dec.
